Cloud architecture design

We design cloud architecture from scratch or rework what you already have, on one cloud, several or a hybrid setup. As simple as the workload allows, and ready to scale when it has to.

Request a call

          

        

      


      

        

          

            
What we do

            
The work, in four parts.

          

          

            
    
              
  1. 
                01
                
    Readiness assessment
    
                
    We study your infrastructure and application landscape to choose the right cloud adoption strategy.
    
              
    2. 
              
  2. 
                02
                
    Design and redesign
    
                
    We draw up new architecture or targeted fixes to what exists, covering compute, storage, networking and failover.
    
              
    3. 
              
  3. 
                03
                
    Cloud-native patterns
    
                
    We favor stateless services, backward-compatible database migrations and managed services wherever they save effort.
    
              
    4. 
              
  4. 
                04
                
    Automation built in
    
                
    Infrastructure as code and CI/CD ship with the design, so the architecture on paper is the one in production.
    
              
    5.
